name: Grasshopper
summary: Face down on the long box with hands on the footbar: bend the arms to bring the chest down as the legs sweep up, then press up into a long back bend and beat the heels.
steps: Lie face down on the long box facing the footbar, hips at the front edge, hands on the bar, arms straight, chest lifted.
Breathe in to bend the elbows, lowering the chest as the legs lift behind.
Bend the knees and beat the heels together a few times.
Breathe out to stretch the legs and press back up.

layers.title: Lower and lift
layers.text: Chest down as the legs sweep up, then press up; no beats.

layers.title: Add the heel beats
layers.text: Beat the heels at the top of the back bend.

cues:
One long curve, like a seesaw over the hips.
Legs together.
Lift the belly to support the lower back.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
